meet.speaker: Relc
meet.text: Oi. Hold up. Big spear, bored Drake, official business. That's me covered. You came off the inn hill. Name and errand.

text_variants.text: Dark road, same Drake. Goblins get bold once the sun's down — so do I.
Hah! The inn's errand-runner. Road's been quiet since you passed. Mostly.
There's the dummy-slayer. Straw fears you. Come here. I owe you something for the show.

options.text: Just a traveler. Staying at the inn, heading for Liscor.
You said you had something for me?
Got time to show me how to fight? (Spar)

options._comment: stage-3 refinement, once per waking. Status quo (relc_spar already re-offers) is unaffected -- this is a SEPARATE payoff option, gated on the SAME stage-3 accomplishment leg as relc_after plus the new once_per_waking seam (the second sanctioned {accomplishment, once_per_waking} compound). No combat-victory-to-dialogue bridge: resolve_combat's victory branch has no dialogue hook to ride (traced -- it banks on_victory accomplishments/loot and returns straight to the field), so the payoff rides the EXISTING next-talk-with-Relc idiom instead, the same shape the gift option above already uses to react to sparred_with_relc.

banter.speaker: Relc
banter.text: Relc. Senior Guardsman, best spear in Liscor, currently guarding grass. The inn feeds you, the city taxes you. Everything between is my road, so behave on it. There's goblins about, if the walk gets boring.

options.text: You any good with that spear? (Spar)

warns.speaker: Relc
warns.text: Goblins on the road since the thaw. A warband near the gate with a chief who's got actual teeth. Old stones to the north-east? Stay off them. And if the pond looks deep, that's because it is.

spar_offer.speaker: Relc
spar_offer.text: Ha! Good instinct. Everyone swings wrong until someone laughs at them. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse; I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules are simple: you move, you hit, you don't cry.

text_variants.text: Again? Fine. The dummies heal fast. Perk of being straw. Same rules: move, hit, no crying.

gift.speaker: Relc
gift.text: My spare spear. Held gates wider than that one. Now listen. Owning a weapon and HOLDING it are different things: check your pack, put the spear in your hand before the road checks your grip. Sword arm, spear arm. The weapon you carry decides which of your moves come with you.

options.text: I’ll try it on. (Check your pack after this.)

relc_army.speaker: Relc
relc_army.text: Ha! No. Army, before. Liscor's got one. It just never comes home. I did. Walls pay worse, but nobody makes you march in the rain, and I am DONE with marching. Best decision I ever made, after the spear.

relc_army_two.speaker: Relc
relc_army_two.text: Long version costs a drink. Short version: I got tired of holes in the ground and people I liked going into them. Watch work, the worst thing I dig is paperwork. ...What? I can be deep. It's the tail, nobody expects it.

relc_after.speaker: Relc
relc_after.text: Miss it? I left people in it. Some I'd still take a spear for, even now. That's all the answer you're getting sober. ...Hey. You did good, down there. I don't say that to walls, so stand still while it lands.

relc_wager.speaker: Relc
relc_wager.text: Ugh — fine, you win. Here's your cut. Watch doesn't pay enough for me to keep losing bets to my own students, but don't tell the paymaster I said that.
